data.title: 在原七海 · 任务后的那句欢迎
data.description: 门刚打开，七海就从厨房探出头来。看到平安回家的恋人，她先松了口气，随后把准备好的热茶端过来：“欢迎回来。”
data.action: offering a cup of tea at the kitchen doorway
data.promptProse: Standing in the warmly lit kitchen doorway, Nanami smiles with relief as she offers a steaming cup of tea to her partner returning home. Soft evening light fills the kitchen, catching the gentle steam rising from the cup, while a glimpse of the tidy counter and shelves in the background completes the welcoming home scene.
data.animaCaption: She offers the tea toward her partner at the door.
